last_result.headline: N5 CLOSED inside its 30-min box: the typewell fingerprint reproduces the deployed group-key neighbour set EXACTLY on all 3 test wells (13/13, 40/40, 13/13, zero difference either way), so it adds nothing over production. Corrects M3 - the byte-hash measured FILE identity, not CURVE identity (files are truncated to different TVT ranges), so typewell sharing is common (13/40/13 near-identical curves), not rare. Byproduct: the deployed round(max(typewell.TVT),1) group key is validated as a lossless proxy, which means n8 must gain from weighting rather than membership.
